# Shekhar Gulati

> > Software engineering blog covering Java, Scala, Python, microservices, cloud platforms (OpenShift), and modern development practices.

Shekhar Gulati shares technical tutorials, productivity insights, and curated content for software developers. The site features hands-on guides for technologies like Java 8, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and cloud deployment, alongside reflections on engineering culture and best practices.

## Key Topics

- Java and Java 8
- Scala
- Python
- OpenShift
- Microservices architecture
- REST API design
- PostgreSQL and MongoDB
- Docker and containers
- Chaos engineering
- Productivity and mental models
- Web development
- Cloud platforms
- Open source
- LLM and AI applications

## Microservices & Cloud Architecture

- [Introducing Chaos Engineering to an Organization](https://shekhargulati.com/2019/04/14/introducing-chaos-engineering-to-an-organization): Guide to adopting chaos engineering in microservices architecture
- [How does FerretDB work?](https://shekhargulati.com/2022/08/03/how-does-ferretdb-work): Technical deep-dive into FerretDB MongoDB proxy over PostgreSQL
- [Talk: Container Performance Analysis](https://shekhargulati.com/2017/05/31/talk-container-performance-analysis): DockerCon 2017 talk summary by Brendan Gregg on container performance
- [Reducing size of Docling Pytorch Docker image](https://shekhargulati.com/2025/02/05/reducing-size-of-docling-pytorch-docker-image): Docker optimization for Docling PyTorch PDF processing microservice

## Java & Scala Development

- [Day 4 — Let's write Null free Java code](https://shekhargulati.com/2015/07/28/day-4-lets-write-null-free-java-code): Java 8 guide to avoiding NullPointerException and null-safe coding
- [Finatra Tutorial — Build Beautiful REST API The Twitter Way](https://shekhargulati.com/2016/01/03/finatra-tutorial-build-beautiful-rest-api-the-twitter-way): Complete Finatra REST API tutorial using Scala and Twitter's stack
- [TIL #7: Java Lambda Puzzler](https://shekhargulati.com/2018/05/23/til-7-java-lambda-puzzler): Java 8 lambda puzzler: converting Stream to Iterable with method refs
- [Quick Tip on Mockito — Mocking Iterator](https://shekhargulati.com/2012/03/11/quick-tip-on-mockito-mocking-iterator): Mockito unit testing tip for mocking Java Iterator behavior

## AI & LLM Applications

- [Adding Web Search to a LLM Chat Application](https://shekhargulati.com/2024/11/05/adding-web-search-to-a-llm-chat-application): Gradio tutorial integrating web search into OpenAI ChatGPT applications

## Productivity & Engineering Culture

- [Mental Models for Software Engineers: Improve Your Productivity by Using the Eisenhower matrix](https://shekhargulati.com/2019/09/01/mental-models-for-software-engineers-improve-your-productivity-by-using-the-eisenhower-matrix): Productivity guide using Eisenhower matrix for task prioritization
- [What Motivates After You Have Met the Baseline?](https://shekhargulati.com/2018/12/08/what-motivates-after-you-have-met-the-baseline): Reflection on intrinsic motivation behind 52-technologies-in-2016 series
- [Issue #25: 10 Reads, A Handcrafted Weekly Newsletter For Software Developers](https://shekhargulati.com/2019/02/21/issue-25-10-reads-a-handcrafted-weekly-newsletter-for-software-developers): Weekly curated newsletter featuring AWS, innovation culture, and dev reads

## Web Development & Tooling

- [Hugo: A Modern WebSite Engine That Just Works](https://shekhargulati.com/2016/02/14/hugo-a-modern-website-engine-that-just-works): Hugo static site generator tutorial using Go and Markdown
- [Day 7 : GruntJS LiveReload : Take Productivity To Another Level](https://shekhargulati.com/2013/11/04/day-7-gruntjs-livereload-take-productivity-to-another-level): GruntJS automation tutorial with LiveReload for improved productivity
- [Implementing file save functionality with Angular 4](https://shekhargulati.com/2017/07/16/implementing-file-save-functionality-with-angular-4): Angular 4 file save implementation using FileSaver.js library
- [Day 23: TimelineJS–Build Beautiful Timelines](https://shekhargulati.com/2013/11/21/day-23-timelinejs-build-beautiful-timelines): TimelineJS tutorial for creating visual timelines on OpenShift

## Optional

- [Run Gradle Builds on OpenShift](https://shekhargulati.com/2013/08/11/run-gradle-builds-on-openshift): Tutorial for configuring Gradle builds on OpenShift Java projects
- [Blog created in couple of minutes using Spring Roo and Cloud Foundry](https://shekhargulati.com/2011/10/02/blog-created-in-couple-of-minutes-using-spring-roo-and-cloud-foundry): Rapid blog development with Spring Roo and Cloud Foundry PaaS deployment
- [How to Write Node.js Applications in Python using PythonJS on OpenShift](https://shekhargulati.com/2014/07/03/how-to-write-node-js-applications-in-python-using-pythonjs-on-openshift-2): PythonJS transpiler tutorial for deploying Python to Node.js on OpenShift
- [Spring Integration RSS Feed Issue](https://shekhargulati.com/2013/03/22/spring-integration-rss-feed-issue): Fix for Spring Integration fetcher.properties classpath error
